```{r in-pw-dat}
# [7420-pw] input power consumption data
serialized_JSON <- '
{
  "A53": {
    "freq": [ 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 1400, 1500 ],

    "2 cores": [ 0.066, 0.078, 0.103, 0.140, 0.166, 0.212, 0.249, 0.319, 0.389, 0.451, 0.531, 0.606 ],
    "3 cores": [ 0.068, 0.097, 0.129, 0.165, 0.209, 0.273, 0.326, 0.415, 0.490, 0.597, 0.707, 0.863 ],
    "4 cores": [ 0.104, 0.132, 0.172, 0.225, 0.270, 0.340, 0.391, 0.491, 0.606, 0.699, 0.859, 1.026 ]

'
dat <- jsonlite::fromJSON(serialized_JSON)
```

```{r plot-pw-curves}
# [7420-pw] plot power consumption curves
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A53$freq, y = dat$A53$`1 core`), color = "blue") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A53$freq, y = dat$A53$`2 cores`), color = "green") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A53$freq, y = dat$A53$`3 cores`), color = "orange") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A53$freq, y = dat$A53$`4 cores`), color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Exynos 7420 Power Consumption Curves (Cortex-A53)",
       x = "Frequency (MHz)", y = "Power Consumption (W)",
       color = "Active Cores") +
  theme_minimal()
q <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A57$freq, y = dat$A57$`1 core`), color = "blue") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A57$freq, y = dat$A57$`2 cores`), color = "green") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A57$freq, y = dat$A57$`3 cores`), color = "orange") +
  geom_line(aes(x = dat$A57$freq, y = dat$A57$`4 cores`), color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Exynos 7420 Power Consumption Curves (Cortex-A57)",
       x = "Frequency (MHz)", y = "Power Consumption (W)",
       color = "Active Cores") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p)
print(q)
```
